channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Urgent need for access to Iranian sites, cautions UN nuclear watchdog
item.description: The IAEA said lack of information and access to facilities to verify Iran's nuclear material is a proliferation concern.

item.title: Palestinians mourn children killed in Israeli airstrikes on Gaza City
item.description: Three Palestinian children were among four people killed in Israeli strikes on Gaza.

item.title: Iranian state media announces numerous US strikes on the country
item.description: Iranian state television has reported numerous strikes on Iranian territory on Tuesday.

item.title: Munitions vehicle explodes killing five in Idlib
item.description: At least five people were killed and several others wounded when a vehicle carrying munitions exploded in Binnish

item.title: Iran retaliates after US strikes kills four at wedding party, state media reports
item.description: Iranian news agencies said retaliatory missile and drone attacks on US targets had begun.

item.title: 'I've never been to Afghanistan': Six million deportees forced to start over under the Taliban
item.description: As of August, the number forced to return this year from Pakistan and Iran had reached another million.

item.title: Israel says Hamas security chief captured as strikes kill four during Gaza raid
item.description: The Israeli military says it carried out strikes in Gaza City during a raid by special forces to capture the head of Hamas's internal security service.

item.title: Woman killed in Times Square stabbing, suspect shot dead by police
item.description: Police say the double stabbing, which injured another person, was random and the suspect had a mental health history.

item.title: 'She slipped out of my hand' - children missing after ferry sinks off northern Cyprus
item.description: Ayten and Hayri Bicer's two young children are among 20 missing in an incident that killed eight people.

item.title: Man arrested after Swiss rave shooting that killed woman
item.description: A 22-year-old Italian woman was killed and several injured at a techno rave in Aarau.
